text:
The products of ADP degradation that rise in the blood during repeated sprints are ammonia, hypoxanthine and uric acid. ADP is converted to AMP, which is deaminated to IMP (releasing ammonia). IMP is then broken down to inosine, hypoxanthine, xanthine and finally uric acid. Urea and creatinine are not products of this pathway.

CONFIDENCE: 93
